function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Here are a few options depending on where you’re located and what kind of cake you’re looking for: | Option | What it offers | How to order | |--------|----------------|--------------| | **Online cake delivery sites** | • Wide variety of flavors, sizes, and designs
• Custom messages & decorations
• Delivery to most addresses | • Go to the website (e.g., **Etsy**, **Goldbelly**, **Blue Apron**, **HelloFresh** for dessert kits)
• Search “birthday cake” or “custom cake”
• Add to cart, enter address, and pay online | | **Local bakeries with online ordering** | • Fresh, often handmade cakes
• Same‑day or next‑day delivery (if within their service area)
• Ability to call for special requests | • Search “cake shop near me” + “online ordering”
• Many have their own websites or use platforms like **Square Online** or **Shopify** | | **Grocery stores with bakery sections** | • Ready‑made cakes or custom orders
• Convenient pickup or delivery via grocery app | • Check the store’s website or app (e.g., **Walmart Grocery**, **Kroger**, **Whole Foods**) for “Bakery” or “Desserts” | | **Specialty cake shops** | • Gourmet or themed cakes (e.g., vegan, gluten‑free, wedding cakes)
• Often offer design consultations | • Look up “specialty cake shop” + your city
• Many have Instagram or Facebook pages where you can DM for orders | | **Subscription services** | • Monthly cake deliveries (great for regular celebrations)
• Variety of seasonal flavors | • Sign up at sites like **Cake Delivery Club** or **The Cake Club** | ### Quick steps to place an order online 1. **Choose a platform** – e.g., Etsy for artisanal cakes, Goldbelly for regional specialties, or a local bakery’s own site. 2. **Search & filter** – Use keywords like “birthday cake,” “vegan cake,” “wedding cake,” or “custom cake.” 3. **Select size & flavor** – Most sites let you choose the diameter, layers, and filling. 4. **Add custom text** – If you want a personalized message, there’s usually a field for that. 5. **Enter delivery details** – Provide the recipient’s address and preferred delivery time window. 6. **Pay securely** – Use credit card, PayPal, or other supported methods. 7. **Confirm & track** – You’ll receive an order confirmation and, in many cases, a tracking link. If you tell me your city or zip code, I can look up specific bakeries or delivery services that operate in your area!
